request.state: How-ever, the larger ionic radius and less negative standard reduction potential (in comparison to lithium ions) have limited the energy density of emerging SIB technology, with recent state-of-the-art full cells demonstrating only [[∼200 Wh/kg]] with respect to active mass.^2−6 On this front, the anode side has proven to be the most challenging, as graphite, the standard LIB anode, cannot intercalate sufficient sodium ions.
